subject: Exec alignment: VP/CTO intro + next steps

Subject: Exec alignment: VP/CTO intro + next steps

Hi Daniel —

Thanks again for the time today — really appreciate the context on Acme Health's latency targets and the multi-region compliance requirements. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum: 

- What we heard: 3ms median latency target for patient-facing features, need private deployment option for PHI workloads, and procurement prefers a short exec-level alignment before tech deep-dive.
- Redwood fit: We can support hosted + private deployments, predictable latency with Dedicated pools, and multiple fallbacks for availability. Vivek (cc'd) will lead the technical deep-dive.

Proposed next step: Executive alignment call (VP/CTO intro) to unblock the procurement and schedule a technical deep-dive with our SEs. Two options that work on our side:
- Wed May 19, 9:00–9:45 AM PT
- Thu May 20, 11:00–11:45 AM PT

If you can confirm which slot works for Sophie (CTO) and Maya (procurement), I’ll send a calendar invite with a short agenda. I’ve added a Calendly link in case you want to pick another time: https://calendly.com/redwood/exec-intro

Agenda (15m exec alignment, 25m ops/next steps):
- Introductions + high-level goals
- Key constraints (security, latency, data residency)
- Proposal: Recommended deployment approach + next milestones
- Action items + decision owner (procurement/technical)

I’ll attach a one-pager for the exec call and a short spec we referenced.

Thanks — talk soon,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
